display_title: 2.5.3 Biobased Circular grote projecten – Demonstratie Energie- en Klimaatinnovatie (DEI+)
call_title: DEI+: Circulaire economie en grootschalige biobased projecten
executive_summary: Grants for large pilots and demonstrations developing circular industrial value chains for polyesters from carbohydrate-rich biological feedstocks. Eligible work includes industrial processing, biopolyester products and recycling. The requested grant must be at least EUR 1,000,001 for a pilot or EUR 10,000,001 for a demonstration, with respective caps of EUR 25 million and EUR 30 million. Enterprises can apply alone or in a consortium. Applications close on 17 December 2026 at 17:00; the EUR 60 million budget is shared with general circular-economy projects and requested funding already exceeds it.
status_rationale: Handleiding DEI+ 2026 sections 2.5.2–2.5.3 and Staatscourant 2026-19339 Article I restrict this subtheme to industrial circular value chains for biobased polyesters, with minimum grant requests specific to large projects. Renewables Grid Initiative (RGI) shares an environmental objective, but neither that project nor the other project files establishes a concrete biopolyester application in electricity infrastructure; general circularity and emissions benefits do not establish a TenneT fit.
